newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AMRAD in asthma research with Rhone-Poulenc.
newsitem.headline: AMRAD in asthma research with Rhone-Poulenc.

text.p: Pharmaceutical researcher AMRAD Corp Lts said on Monday it has entered a joint venture with French drug company, Rhone-Poulenc Rorer Inc to search for treatments of asthma related illnesses.

"AMRAD will receive research payments of A$15 million over five years, as well as significant milestone payments for discoveries made AMRAD will also receive royalties on the sales of any pharmaceutical products marketed front these discoveries," the company said in a statement.

The company said during the five year deal it would test extracts derived from natural products against proprietary screens to identify compounds with biological activity relating to asthma and related inflammatory respiratory disease.

"The market for asthma drugs worldwide currently exceeds A$2 billion each year, and is growing. If this collaboration develops a new treatment for asthma, the potential value of milestone payments and royalties to AMRAD would be extremely large," AMRAD Managing director John Grace said.
AMRAD has previously established natural products screening collaborations with Japan's Chugai Pharmaceutical Co and Canada's BioChem Pharma Inc.
